== Merge of Jim Van Fleet (27 October 2026) ==

'''Build notes'''
* [[James Van Fleet|Jim Van Fleet]] (Squadron Member page) was merged into this page and now redirects here. Both pages were about the same person: Decipher's Coruscant region page lists "Flight Leader Red 15, James VanFleet, Mifflinburg, PA" (https://web.archive.org/web/20010115091600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/coruscant.html, strict_check ok 27 October 2026), and the fan-site roster lists Red 15 FL Jim Van Fleet of Mifflinburg, Pa.
* Carried over: the Service row, the fan-site roster ref, the Players Committee reprint link (Preserved copy moved to the working capture 20261025162059), and the Squadron Members and History categories. The Coruscant region page is now cited for the Flight Leader row.
* Links on [[People]], [[People/F]] and [[Squadron Members]] now point here.
* No Decipher Squadron profile of his survives in the Internet Archive, so there is no In their own words section.
* The notes below were on [[Talk:Jim Van Fleet]], copied here so they stay with the article. That page keeps its history.

=== Notes carried over from Talk:Jim Van Fleet ===
==== Service claim needs a source ====
The article names him as tournament organizer in a 2005 archived DeckTech ''LOTR'' report, but that sentence has no citation, and it is not clear the event was SWCCG. Under the Service-table rule (Bill, 2026-10-14), service mentioned on a person page must be a cited row in its == Service == table. The article was left unchanged; please add a source (and then a Service row), or remove the claim. == "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 02:42, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
